claims.claim: Hugging Face publishes the Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard with covered benchmarks including HeQ, HebrewSentiment, Hebrew Winograd, Translation En<->He, and Hebrew Trivia (the canonical benchmark set this skill evaluates against).
The live Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard space is at huggingface.co/spaces/hebrew-llm-leaderboard/leaderboard.

Dicta-LM 3.0 technical report (published February 2026 by Dicta) documents the 24B (Mistral-Small-3.1 base), 12B Nemotron (NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 base), and 1.7B (Qwen3-1.7B base) variants, plus a benchmark suite covering Translation, Summarization, Winograd, Israeli Trivia, and Diacritization.
Dicta publishes its Hebrew open-weight LLM family on Hugging Face under huggingface.co/dicta-il.
AI21's Jamba models list Hebrew (he) among their supported languages, alongside English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Arabic.
claims.verification_note: The previously cited ai21.com blog post returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients and could not be read, so the claim was re-sourced to the model's own card metadata on HuggingFace, where cardData.language includes 'he'. Note the AI21-Jamba model repos are gated ('gated': 'auto'), so the README itself is not fetchable unauthenticated; the API metadata is.

claims.claim: EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness is the canonical open-source framework for running standardized LLM evaluations and is hosted at github.com/EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness.
UK AISI's Inspect framework for AI evaluations is hosted at github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai.
HeQ is a Hebrew extractive question-answering benchmark of 30,147 question-answer pairs drawn from Hebrew Wikipedia and Israeli tech news.
claims.raw_snippet: 30,147 diverse question-answer pairs derived from both Hebrew Wikipedia articles and Israeli tech news.

claims.claim: The Israeli National NLP Program maintains a Hebrew-Resources catalog on GitHub at github.com/NNLP-IL/Hebrew-Resources.
The Etelis/HeQ_v1 HuggingFace mirror hosts HeQ: 30,147 Modern Hebrew questions following the SQuAD/ParaShoot format.
claims.raw_snippet: HeQ is a question answering dataset in Modern Hebrew, consisting of 30,147 questions. It follows the format and crowdsourcing methodology of SQuAD and ParaShoot, with paragraphs sourced from Hebrew Wikipedia and Geektime.

claims.claim: HebrewSentiment is the Hebrew sentiment dataset published by the Israeli National NLP Program at huggingface.co/datasets/HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment; verify license and split sizes on the live dataset card before commercial use.
HebNLI is the Hebrew natural-language-inference dataset published by the Israeli National NLP Program at huggingface.co/datasets/HebArabNlpProject/HebNLI.
The Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard evaluates models on four Hebrew-specific datasets built for the leaderboard.
